coverage.rosters: 1970 to 2025 (nflverse season roster files 1970 to 2001, the site roster table 2002 to 2025)
coverage.draft: nfl_draft_picks 1936 to 2025, treated as complete from 1990

rules.teams: roster rows with status in ACT, RES, INA (ACT, RES, INA, PUP in the 1970 to 2001 files), historical codes mapped to the franchise's current code by season, modern codes merged through nfl_team_codes
rules.identity: gsis_id where any row carries one; otherwise name plus birth date, bridged to a gsis_id when a row of the same name and birth date has one
rules.pos: distinct raw roster position codes on those rows
rules.draft: roster draft_number and draft_club when present; else the nfl_draft_picks row matching name and entry year; else, with no entry year, the one pick row of that name in the three drafts up to the first season; else undrafted when the entry year is 1990 or later and no pick within a year matches; else null
rules.stats: regular season rows summed per season by gsis_id: seasons with 4,000 passing, 1,000 rushing, 1,000 receiving yards
rules.sbWins: from 2002 roster rows with game_type SB on the winner super_bowls names for season plus one; before 2002 a counted roster row on the winning franchise that season
rules.display: the name alone when nobody shares it; else, per name group, the first of name (first-last), name (first-last, TEAM), name (first-last, TEAM, POS) that tells every namesake apart
